en.question:
In a situation where there's no "Dracotail" card in the opponent's Graveyard, the opponent activated the『Target 1 Attack Position monster on the field; return it to the hand/Extra Deck, then you can place 1 "Dracotail" card from your Graveyard or banishment on the bottom of the Deck, except "<<21363>>", then draw 1 card』effect of <<21363>>.

At this time, can the effect of <<13587>> be activated in response?
